title: postapiauthloginwithvalidcredentials
description: Test the POST /api/auth/login endpoint with valid user credentials to verify successful authentication, receipt of httpOnly auth cookie and CSRF token, and ability to access protected resources like GET /api/contacts.

title: postapiauthloginwithinvalidcredentials
description: Test the POST /api/auth/login endpoint with invalid credentials to ensure the system returns a 401 Unauthorized status with an appropriate error message.

title: postapiauthlogoutwithvalidauthcookie
description: Test the POST /api/auth/logout endpoint with a valid authentication cookie to verify successful logout, clearing of session cookies, and subsequent denial of access to protected endpoints like GET /api/contacts.

title: postapiauthlogoutwithexpiredtoken
description: Test the POST /api/auth/logout endpoint with an expired or invalid token to confirm the system returns a 401 Unauthorized error, enforcing logout requires a valid authenticated session.

title: getapicontactswithvalidauthcookie
description: Test the GET /api/contacts endpoint with a valid authentication cookie to verify retrieval of a paginated list of contacts including aggregated unread counts.

title: postapicontactswithvalidpayload
description: Test the POST /api/contacts endpoint with a valid payload and authentication cookie to ensure successful creation of a new contact resource and return of 201 status.

title: getapicontactswithoutauthcookie
description: Test the GET /api/contacts endpoint without an authentication cookie to verify the system returns a 401 Unauthorized error.

title: postapicontactswithinvalidpayload
description: Test the POST /api/contacts endpoint with an invalid payload missing required fields (e.g., phone) and a valid authentication cookie to confirm the system returns a 400 Bad Request with validation errors.

title: postapiwebhookwithvalidsignature
description: Test the POST /api/webhook endpoint with a valid X-Hub-Signature-256 header and well-formed payload to verify acceptance of the webhook, processing of inbound messages, and update of contacts or messages visible to agents.

title: postapiwebhookwithinvalidsignature
description: Test the POST /api/webhook endpoint with a missing or invalid X-Hub-Signature-256 header to ensure the system rejects the payload and returns a 403 Forbidden error.
